pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, soft night atmosphere)

Should I rise again
the sky waits quietly

A small light
breathing in the dark

[Verse 1]
Tonight moves slowly
through a tired city
broken thoughts
rest on silent streets

Yet somewhere deeper
a heartbeat returns
like a faint glow
behind the clouds

[Chorus]
Slowly I rise
a step toward the sky

Even the smallest light
shows the way

Falling was part
of the long road here

And still
the sky remains open

[Verse 2]
The world may push
like a restless wind
but flowers return
to forgotten ground

A quiet light
rests on my shoulders
whispering softly
that it's alright

The higher I look
the clearer it feels
shadows fading
behind the morning

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, reflective and slowly uplifting)

[Bridge]
One step
then another

the night listening
without a word

Hope moves quietly
through the chest

growing
like a hidden star

[Chorus]
Now I rise again
into the open air

The sky grows wider
with every breath

No hurry
no fear

Just wings learning
how to move again

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, fading with gentle ambience)

The night grows calm

And somewhere above

the sky
keeps waiting
